name: Quetiapine
effects: Transient D2 blockade plus strong H1/5HT2A antagonism
Strong sedation at low doses (H1 dominant) — widely misused for insomnia
Moderate metabolic effects: weight gain, dyslipidemia, glucose elevation
Very low EPS risk due to rapid D2 dissociation
Active metabolite norquetiapine has norepinephrine reuptake inhibition
